text_block_list.text: Ever since she returned, Cesario had been rewatching the previous race non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: My timing to make a move... was far too naive as well.
choice_data_list: Maybe you shouldn't push yourself so hard right now...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, I must sear this into my memory.
This pathetic sight of myself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...So that I'll never forget this frustration.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: In order to keep my eyes firmly set... on the wall I must overcome from now on.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure... you make a comeback!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: In order to keep my eyes firmly set... on the wall I must overcome from now on.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure... you make a comeback!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If you ask me whether this is just me putting on a brave face... I'm not entirely sure myself.
choice_data_list: If acting tough gives you strength, then there's nothing wrong with it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will etch what was just said into my heart
as the words of an experienced mentor.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: So that one day, when the time comes... I can pass these feelings I have right now on to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I promise I'll become stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The anxiety of being caught up to, the frustration of being pulled away from.
Even the despair of losing momentum."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Using every single experience as fuel, leaving nothing behind.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Because doing so should lead to my victory... and the victory of future generations.
